CheckboxGroup.description: A `<div role="group">` around checkboxes that share one value: the list of the checked boxes' values. Inside a FieldRoot it is the field's control.

props.value: The values of the checked boxes. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the group.
props.defaultValue: The values checked at first, when the group isn't controlled.
props.onValueChange: Called with the new list when the user checks or clears a box, or presses the parent box.
props.allValues: Every value a box in the group can have. Needed for a parent box, which checks all of them.
props.disabled: Disables every box in the group natively.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the group is disabled, by its own prop or by its Field or Fieldset.
dataAttributes.data-invalid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.
dataAttributes.data-valid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.
dataAttributes.data-touched: Inside a FieldRoot: present once focus has been in the group and left it.
dataAttributes.data-dirty: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the list differs from its initial one.
dataAttributes.data-filled: Inside a FieldRoot: present while at least one box is checked.
dataAttributes.data-focused: Inside a FieldRoot: present while focus is on one of the boxes.
